title: Historia general de las cosas de Nueva España (Florentine Codex), book 4 folio 69r
version: Getty Research Institute 2023 digital edition, 1577 manuscript; Nahuatl transcription and Anderson–Dibble English translation
lineage: This is a digital edition and modern translation of an Indigenous and Franciscan-authored early modern manuscript. The description is an ethnographic account rather than a dated witnessed instance.

passages.note: Book 4 folio 69r, Nahuatl transcription and English translation in embedded page data; Getty citation dates the completed manuscript to 1577.
